verdict.rationale: Runloop documents command execution in Devboxes (execute-commands), stateful named shells, an interactive PTY, and SSH access into isolated Linux sandboxes, which covers running arbitrary shell commands. Package installation is supported through Dockerfile-based blueprints and reusable startup actions, though not shown as an explicit runtime install. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of installing packages at runtime (e.g. apt/pip inside a running devbox), independent or hands-on corroboration.
